properties.title: GRID3 Lesotho Settlement Extents Version 01, Alpha
properties.description: NOTE: This version of the Lesotho settlement extents has been superseded by "GRID3 Lesotho Settlement Extents, Version 01.01", now available here: https://doi.org/10.7916/d8-68p3-mb97 The database constitutes a comprehensive set of settlement polygons nationwide. It is in geodatabase format and consists of three feature classes for built up areas (BUA), small settlement areas (SSA), and hamlets (hamlets). This work has been undertaken as part of the Geo-referenced Infrastructure and Demographic Data for Development (GRID3) initiative in Lesotho. GRID3 works with countries to generate, validate and use geospatial data on population, settlements, infrastructure, and subnational boundaries. For more information, see https://grid3.org/ Keywords: built up areas, BUA, small settlement areas, SSA, hamlets, settlement aggregation, settlement extent, CIESIN, GRID3, Novel-T
